summary: One pull request. In packages/envoy/internal/dispatch/refs: replace resolveNodes' switch with a node-kind registry (nodeLoaders, kind -> loader; nodeKinds derived from it); resolveNodes skips a kind with no entry instead of failing; BacklinkCounts adds `from_kind = any(nodeKinds)` so a count counts the rows its list shows; Outgoing adds `e.to_kind = any(nodeKinds)` so the older artifacts/{id}/references route lists no unknown target. Tests first (refs_test.go, api/references_test.go, e2e/references.e2e.ts), run red at the test commit and green at the fix; docs in cmd/dispatch/README.md 'Reference graph', envoy AGENTS.md:1862, envoy CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed.
tasks: Task 0: rootless Postgres 17 + pgvector harness under /legion/harness (docs/solutions/testing INFRA-42, INFRA-43 recipes), 127.0.0.1:55432 trust auth so `bun run dispatch:local` works; DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL for Go tests; own ports and database per role.

Task 1 (commit test(dispatch): graph reads around a node kind this build does not know): refs_test.go TestGraphReadsSkipANodeKindThisBuildCannotAddress (in, out, unknown-only in project OPS, counts with and without excludeKinds); api/references_test.go TestReferencesAnswerAroundAnEdgeOfAKindThisBuildCannotAddress (?to=, ?from=, issue referenced_by_count == listed edges) and TestArtifactReferencesSkipANodeKindThisBuildCannotAddress (referenced_by and outgoing, known unresolved targets kept); e2e/references.e2e.ts 'an issue's backlinks skip an edge of a node kind this build does not know' (header Referenced by (2), panel lists the message, no 'Referenced by unavailable.'). Record each failure with -v.
Task 2 (commit fix(dispatch): a graph read skips an edge to a node kind it does not know): the registry, resolveNodes skip, BacklinkCounts and Outgoing filters, doc comments.
Task 3: README 'Reference graph', envoy AGENTS.md:1862, envoy CHANGELOG [Unreleased] Fixed; grep docs/site dispatch docs and skills/dispatch for a statement made false; check-private-names.sh passes.

Task 4: harness proofs C1-C5 at the head with negative controls at the test commit, simplify pass, push, open the PR from the template; the body says this must run in production before dispatch://INFRA-366 merges and that INFRA-366 adds a `block` entry to nodeLoaders. Locally run only the three Go tests and the one Playwright test; CI runs the lanes.

findings.finding: Counts (issue header, every ask read, replayed ask events via attachAskBacklinkCounts) count an unknown-kind row that the list omits; the tree plan accepted a count one high during the rollout.
findings.answer: BacklinkCounts filters from_kind to the registry's node kinds; refs-level test covers counts with and without excludeKinds; API test asserts issue referenced_by_count equals the listed edges; C2. Departure from the tree plan recorded in plan.md.

findings.finding: Outgoing on GET /api/v1/artifacts/{id}/references lists an unknown target as {kind, to_id}, independently of resolveNodes.
findings.answer: Outgoing filters to_kind to the registry's node kinds; known non-artifact and dangling known artifact targets keep their unresolved entry; TestArtifactReferencesSkipANodeKindThisBuildCannotAddress and C3.

findings.finding: Production holds no unknown-kind row, so a production curl cannot exercise the skip.
findings.answer: C6 is scoped to the build and route (production check script plus read-only curl); the skip is proven pre-merge by C1-C5 on the real server and database; INFRA-366's spec already says its rollout is where A12 is first observed in production. No production write.

findings.finding: Tests must cover both directions, the unknown-only case and content, not just HTTP 200; dispatch read degrades a failed graph read silently; the PR2 driver block-graph.sh does not exist yet.
findings.answer: Go tests cover in, out, unknown-only (empty non-nil) and counts; API tests assert retained identities and absent unknown kinds; C4 requires the comment under Referenced by and no unavailable row; drivers are curl, the CLI and Playwright, all available now.

findings.finding: The deployment instructions' browser rule applies: the issue page's panel and count change for a person.
findings.answer: Task 1 item 4 adds a Playwright row in e2e/references.e2e.ts against the real server with a psql-inserted row; run red at the test commit and green at the head (C5).

findings.finding: A node-kind registry changes the sibling's extension recipe (add case block to resolveNodes); an incomplete change would silently skip or uncount block edges; refs.Kinds/KnownKind are edge kinds.
findings.answer: One map is the only source for resolution, counts and Outgoing, documented as node kinds; refs.Kinds untouched; the PR body and the completion summary tell the architect that INFRA-366 adds a block entry to nodeLoaders and tests block listed and counted while future stays skipped.

findings.finding: The pod has no Docker or Postgres; storetest skips without DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL, so a green run may be all skips.
findings.answer: Task 0 uses the documented rootless Postgres + pgvector recipe on the issue volume; Go runs use -v and must show PASS, not SKIP, for the three tests.
